description: DiligenceOps: submit a guarantee as promised (money-back, performance or satisfaction) and the guarantee terms. The signed report lists every deadline, condition and exclusion in the terms that differs from the promise: a shorter or differently counted window, named conditions such as proof of purchase or original packaging, exclusions, fees deducted from the refund and credit in place of money, each quoted. POST /api/guarantee-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-vendor-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

promise.description: The guarantee as promised, for example "30-day money-back guarantee, no questions asked".

terms.description: The guarantee terms, up to 256 KB.

terms_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.
